about.title: OUR STORY
about.p1: Stroke opened in Salò in 2003, when few people in the Brescia province had even heard of streetwear and board culture. More than twenty years later we're still here, on the shores of Lake Garda, with the same idea as day one: bringing to a lake town the brands you could only find in big cities.
about.p2: Our way of buying has always been against the grain: many styles, one piece per size. No walls of identical hoodies. Whoever walks into Stroke finds pieces they won't see on everyone — and whoever buys online from us is literally buying the piece hanging in the shop.
about.p3: That's why every order on this site is a reservation: before charging you, we check the piece is still here. A bit slower? Maybe. But nobody ever gets a surprise refund for an item sold two hours earlier at the counter.
about.visitText: We're in Salò, on Lake Garda. If you're around for the lake, drop by: the shop itself is the best piece in the collection.
